_help: Tokenomics Generator settings. groups: the supply groups with a colour. Each template sets pct (percent of supply) and vesting: tge (percent unlocked at launch), cliff (months before vesting starts) and vest (months of linear unlocking after the cliff). months: how far the charts look ahead. warnings: each rule has a message; {placeholders} are filled in. Change the numbers in limits to make the warnings stricter or looser.

warnings.notHundred: The groups add up to {total}%, not 100%.
warnings.teamNoVesting: Team gets {pct}% with no vesting, so they could sell on day one.
warnings.teamHigh: Team gets {pct}%, above {limit}%. Buyers may see that as too much.
warnings.insiders: Insiders (team, investors and advisors) hold {pct}%, above {limit}%.
warnings.firstYear: {pct}% of the supply unlocks in the first 12 months after launch. Expect selling pressure.
warnings.bigMonth: Month {month} unlocks {pct}% of the supply at once.
warnings.lowLiquidity: Liquidity is only {pct}%. Thin liquidity makes the price jumpy.
warnings.lowCommunity: Community and airdrop get only {pct}%, below {limit}%.
warnings.noTge: Almost nothing is unlocked at launch, so there is little to trade.
warnings.allGood: No big red flags by these rules. That does not make the design good, just not obviously risky.
